notes: Reviewed command-center/audit/AUD-0033-doc-path-reference-integrity.json cold, with no prior exposure to the AUD-0033 authoring transcript. Goal was to FALSIFY the headline claim 'SCOPED: 1705 EXISTS / 4127 MISSING of 5832 from 4077 files'. All falsification attempts failed to move the headline; the receipt's counts hold up under independent re-execution and manual spot-checking. One genuine, but already-disclosed, methodological weakness was found in probe2's DELETED-vs-NEVER-EXISTED breakdown (see falsification_attempts #6); it does not change the EXISTS/MISSING/distinct-token headline figures under review and the receipt already carries an open 'residual_unknowns' item (verdict NOT-CHECKED) covering exactly this gap, so it is not a false claim, just an acknowledged scope limit. Recommend the receipt's own outstanding item (raise MAX_MISSING / re-sample probe2 across the full missing set, not just command-center/-prefixed paths first) be tracked as a follow-up, but it does not invalidate the reviewed headline. Restored probe1-existence.raw.txt and probe1-results.json to their committed (git-tracked) contents after re-running the probes, since this review must not leave edits to receipt-adjacent artifacts; did not touch the AUD-0033 receipt itself or commit anything.

falsification_attempts.attempt: Re-execute python3 -B command-center/p2-wave/probes/AUD-0033/path_reference_probe.py from a clean shell and diff its emitted distinct/exists/missing counts against the receipt's headline and extensions.p1 block.
falsification_attempts.detail: distinct_tokens=5832, exists=1705, missing=4127 reproduced exactly, matching both the receipt headline ('SCOPED: 1705 EXISTS / 4127 MISSING of 5832') and extensions.p1. control_ok=True, counterexamples_ok=True also reproduced.

falsification_attempts.attempt: Re-execute python3 -B command-center/p2-wave/probes/AUD-0033/git_history_probe.py and diff class_counts / planted_ok against receipt extensions.p2.
falsification_attempts.detail: class_counts={'NEVER-EXISTED': 40, 'DELETED': 0, 'ERROR': 0}, planted_ok=True reproduced exactly against the freshly regenerated probe1-results.json.

falsification_attempts.attempt: Re-execute python3 -B command-center/p2-wave/probes/AUD-0033/refute_resolver_control.py to check the good/mutant extractor and naive/fixed resolver still discriminate as claimed.
falsification_attempts.detail: discriminates=True reproduced: mutant extractor fires on planted prose traps (input/output, this/that) while the good extractor stays silent; naive is_file() resolver misses source-relative and directory targets (local-rel-target.txt, .agents/skills) while the fixed multi-candidate resolver finds them, matching the two negative-control descriptions AUD0033-C1/C2 verbatim.

falsification_attempts.attempt: Random sample of 25 identities marked EXISTS in probe1-results.json; independently check (repo-root)/token with a fresh Python one-liner, bypassing the probe's own resolver.
falsification_attempts.detail: 21/25 resolved directly at repo root. The remaining 4 (scripts/Start-BrowserRail.ps1, scripts/deploy.sh, scripts/test_acceptance_review.py, references/workflow.md) are false alarms from checking repo-root-only rather than the probe's documented source-relative resolution rule: each is cited inside a skill's own SKILL.md/README.md (e.g. .agents/skills/browser-rail/SKILL.md) and resolves correctly to that skill's own scripts/ or references/ subdirectory (e.g. .agents/skills/browser-rail/scripts/Start-BrowserRail.ps1, which exists). Traced citing files and confirmed all 4 resolve under resolve_exists()'s source.parent/token candidate, so the EXISTS classification is correct, not falsified.

falsification_attempts.attempt: Random sample of 40 identities marked MISSING in probe1-results.json (seed=7); re-run the probe's own multi-candidate resolve_exists(token, citing_file) against every citing file found for each token, independent of the cached identities dict.
falsification_attempts.detail: 0/40 resolved under any candidate (repo-root, citing-file-relative, or cwd-relative). Included plausible-looking but ultimately non-existent paths such as '.git/hooks/pre-commit', 'skills/tooluniverse-computational-biophysics/scripts/iv_drip_rate.py', and 'agent-skills-toolchain/tools/mcp/canonical-mcp-servers.json'; all confirmed absent from the working tree at every candidate location.

falsification_attempts.attempt: Independently git log --all a handful of paths appearing in probe1's 'missing_sample' preview (a superset of what probe2 actually searched) to check for DELETED-vs-NEVER-EXISTED misclassification.
falsification_attempts.detail: 'tools/web/agentify-desktop' (MISSING, correctly so - it is absent from the working tree) has 12 commits in git history (deleted by 'chore: retire the ChatGPT-web orchestration lane'), so it is really DELETED, not NEVER-EXISTED. However this path was NOT among the actual 40 identities probe2 searched (probe2's prefer_missing() sort fills its 40-item budget with command-center/-prefixed paths first, and 'tools/web/agentify-desktop' fell into the unsearched leftover_uncapped=4087 pool). So the receipt's literal claim (class_counts for the 40 items it actually sampled = all NEVER-EXISTED) is not falsified, but it does confirm the receipt's own residual_unknowns entry ('All leftover MISSING identities beyond Probe 2 budget are classified' -> verdict NOT-CHECKED) is a real, live gap rather than a formality: the true NEVER-EXISTED/DELETED split across all 4127 MISSING identities is unproven and probe2's alphabetical/prefix-biased sampling likely undercounts DELETED. This does not change the EXISTS=1705/MISSING=4127/distinct=5832 headline under review, which concerns filesystem-existence today, not historical git status.

falsification_attempts.attempt: Diff files_scanned between the receipt (4077) and this independent re-run (4088) to check whether repo drift since the receipt's timestamp silently changed the sweep's scope without updating the headline.
falsification_attempts.detail: git status showed the working tree gained committed files under command-center/p2-wave/probes/AUD-0032/ and AUD-0045/ between the receipt's ended_at (2026-09-07T11:50:47Z) and this review (concurrent audit work in the same repo). This added 11 more scanned files, but distinct_tokens/exists/missing reproduced bit-for-bit identical (5832/1705/4127), i.e. the newly added files contributed no new distinct path-identities that shifted the headline. Logged as an environmental note, not a falsification.
